editorial.meta_description: The CHTP certification from HFTP covers hospitality applications, technology management, and core technology for professionals working in the hospitality.
editorial.overview: The Certified Hospitality Technology Professional (CHTP) is a professional credential offered by Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals (HFTP). The exam covers three distinct areas: Hospitality Applications, Technology Management, and Core Technology. It is intended for technology executives and professionals working within the hospitality sector who need to demonstrate their expertise in integrating operational systems with technical infrastructure to improve business performance and guest satisfaction.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is designed for technology professionals currently working in the hospitality industry. Candidates must meet specific education and experience requirements to qualify for the exam and demonstrate their professional competency.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Candidates should utilize the review materials provided in the online course, which include slides, podcasts, and videos. Practice quizzes are available to help prepare for the proctored exam. The application process must be completed and approved before accessing the exam sections. Candidates may also contact the academy for information on the Certification Advisory Program for one-to-one support to ensure they are prepared for the testing experience.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses on the various software and digital applications used within hospitality operations to facilitate guest services, manage reservations, and streamline business processes for modern hotels and resorts.

This domain covers the management of technology assets, including strategic planning, operational oversight, and the administration of technical teams in a hospitality environment to ensure high levels of service and efficiency.

This domain addresses the underlying technical concepts, infrastructure, and security protocols required to support hospitality technology systems, ensuring that all data remains protected and systems remain functional for the entire organization.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam is proctored via Proctorio, allowing for access from any location. Ensure your environment meets the requirements for online proctoring. Candidates must be prepared to complete the exam sections to achieve the required results.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 190 questions in total, which are divided across the three required sections. Candidates must be prepared to answer these questions within the allotted time frame provided by the testing platform.

Candidates must achieve a passing score of 70 percent for each of the three sections to earn the CHTP designation. It is required to meet this threshold in every individual section to successfully complete the certification requirements.

faq.question_title: Is there a specific exam path?
faq.answer_text: The certification process is structured to validate your professional knowledge in hospitality technology. If you have questions regarding the current certification path or future updates, please check with Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals (HFTP) for the current certification path.

The exam is delivered through an online proctoring system. This allows candidates to take the test from a location of their choice, provided they have a stable internet connection and meet the technical requirements for the proctoring software.

methodology.summary: This editorial was developed by analyzing official HFTP exam guides and third-party certification documentation to provide a factual overview of the CHTP requirements, structure, and professional standards for all prospective candidates.
